motivation: Ferguson control arm: MID_GREY rows at 35-69 implied 1.29-1.52x frozen dose at x5/x10 while WHITE rows at 111 implied 0.88-0.90. Corpus 25-32/T6 low grey rows are flat. Post-hoc; needs out-of-corpus test.

hypothesis.H-YG: For players aged 18-21, MID_GREY marginal cost below latent coordinate 80 is g = 0.65 of the flat-zone cost; unchanged otherwise.
hypothesis.H0: Frozen model: flat cost below the class threshold for every age.

controls: Y: a player NOT in the corpus, age 18-21, T0, with at least two MID_GREY affected stats below 70 on the x5 or x10 Drill Session coach.
O: a player NOT in the corpus, age 24-29, T0, with at least two MID_GREY affected stats below 70 on the same coach(es).
coaches: Drill Session Standard Attacking x5 (Passing, Dribbling, Finishing)
Drill Session Standard Offensive x10 (Crossing, Shooting, Speed, Creativity)
design.procedure: Cards (incl. the preview's Avg: X (Y) values if visible on the card, else from the first preview) are sent first; predictions under H0 and H-YG are frozen and pushed; then previews only, nothing applied.

decisionRules: H-YG is supported if, on Y's MID_GREY rows below 70, H-YG has lower midpoint MAE than H0 AND, on O's MID_GREY rows below 70, H0 is no worse than H-YG by more than 0.5 (the effect must be age-specific).
H-YG is falsified if Y's low MID_GREY rows imply dose within 0.90-1.10 of H0, or if O's low MID_GREY rows imply dose >= 1.25 of H0 (then the effect is not age-specific).
WHITE rows are reported but not used for the decision.
leakageRules: No control previews enter any prediction.
g and the knot are fixed by this file.
